payload.detail: Exact candidate 7c7858f3c6aac5277bb34e905b532828d22da1a2: Scala type-discipline review clean. All new vocabulary remains private[bench]/private[nfrd]; DiagnosticOriginSpec is checked before receipt construction; origin and artifact-reference canonicalization uses explicit fixed-arity tagged fields rather than render/toString; errors are explicit ADT cases; no casts, nulls, suppressions, sentinel encodings, partial production indexing, new public case-class proof products, or stale match sites. Root, reason, fixed-artifact relocation, and participant-directory relocation mutants each change the complete receipt without disclosing paths; restoring origin or reference omission makes the named court fail.
